name: kiasumiles
description: Local-first Singapore credit-card miles optimizer for Codex via MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex which Singapore miles card to use at a merchant.
interface.longDescription: KiasuMiles bundles a local MCP server and agent guidance for Singapore credit-card miles recommendations. It keeps merchant lookup, wallet filtering, and card ranking offline at query time.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KiasuMiles to help me choose the best card for a Singapore merchant.
